title: Convergence Analysis of Block Newton Methods for 1D Shallow Neural Network Approximation
summary: This paper analyzes local convergence of the block Newton (BN) method introduced in [5, 6] for one-dimensional shallow neural network approximation to functions and diffusion-reaction problems. The BN method consists of the 2x2 block nonlinear Gauss-Seidel, linear Gauss-Seidel, or Jacobi method for outer iteration and the Newton method for inner iteration. The blocks are corresponding to the linear and the nonlinear parameters.
